name: Susanna Szljacsan — husband Joannes Janeczky and daughter Susanna
researcher_question: Who did Susanna Szljacsan of Lisková, Ružomberok, Slovakia marry, and did she have a daughter named Susanna, baptized about 1884?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples.csv row 29, flags adds_spouse/adds_daughter, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-08-04 as outcome (a), true match: findings kept as transcribed, nothing added. The couple is corroborated by four further Lisková baptisms independent of the hint (1875, 1882, 1889, 1891), and the same-name pool is eliminated on age — six of eight candidates chronologically impossible, the seventh bearing a child at 49 — leaving no viable competitor. An earlier pass held the identity at 'probable, not proved' and added a hedge finding f3; both were withdrawn on review, since absence of a parentage statement is the normal condition of 19th-century Slovak parish research and 'true but only probable' is not one of this genre's three outcomes. See README 'Notes for reviewers'.
